customer: Hi there, I recently relocated to Eastvale and I'm thinking about selling my coupe, but it's still registered in the state I moved from. Is that something Northwind Auto can help with, and what should I bring? Thank you!
agent: Welcome to Eastvale! We buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one, so your coupe's out-of-state registration isn't a problem. Please bring the registration from the state that issued it. If the title happens to be lost, the duplicate rules of the issuing state apply, and our article "Selling a paid-off car when the title is lost" covers that.
